title: Cardano Builder Asia - Building a Connected Cardano Builder Network in Asia

ms.promise:
・Form a core team from various builder communities across Asia
・Develop a detailed plan for activities and community events for the next six months
・Set up official communication channels (Discord, Telegram, email)
・Host the first online meetup to introduce the project and gather community feedback
ms.criteria:
・Public announcement of the team
・Provide a project plan on official channels
・Establish communication networks with at least 30 initial members from the Cardano community in Asia
・Successfully conduct the first online meetup with at least 20 participants
ms.report:
Here is the respective evidence of the deliverables:
Link to the public announcement of the team
・The Cardano Asia Community Team was announced at the initial online meetup, see the recording at: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvByn7bi6to 
・To summarise, the Team consists of 4 Cardano Projects in the Asia region, each one represented by a leading member of each project: 
・Mesh - Singapore, represented by Jingles 
・SIDAN Lab - HongKong, represented by Kinson
・Socious - Japan, represented by Taichi Yokoyama
・Cardano Vietnam - Vietnam Community, represented by Ha Nguyen
・Their role is to share workloads and efforts to successfully lead and implement the pro

Link to the Discord channel for project plan announcement
・The project plan, which has been shared at the first online meetup and summarised on the forum, has been additionally posted at the #announcements channel on the Cardano Asia Community Discord
・The link to the Discord channel where we post updates and announcements has been set up at: https://discordapp.com/channels/1268463750449598474/1268463750449598477 
・We will use the #announcements channel for upcoming news and updates
・Screenshot of Discord channel to verify https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ELsMLmIPBakF7gS41HuEIKbce-h4bYQw/view?usp=drive_link
・Discord server link: https://discord.gg/6JU8VVrBmW

ms.promise:
・Organize in-person meetups in 1-2 countries, such as Singapore, Hong Kong, or Vietnam.
・Launch a mentorship program to support new builder and developer projects.
ms.criteria:
・Successfully host 1-2 meetups with at least 20 participants per event.
・Establish at least five mentor-mentee pairs to support ongoing projects.
ms.report:
Hey there, Milestone reviewers and anyone who is following the progress of this proposal. Here we are, reporting the successful completion of Milestone 3.

The acceptance criteria have been stated as
Successfully host 1-2 meetups with at least 20 participants per event.
Establish at least five mentor-mentee pairs to support ongoing projects.
And here our proof of achievements in detail:
1) Hosting at least one meetup with at least 20 participants:
The meetup was successfully held on monday, October 27, 2025 in Hong Kong by SIDAN Lab. 
Event images can be found at:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Yk2OXWUuWEPplBy7_3LLe8PppHPp2aH6?usp=sharing
Event attendee list can be found at:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KhoLr19fK9iLfZQ0NGCG748EI4R084G7b5EPtXOUrI8/edit?gid=0#gid=0
A tweet summarising the event can be found at
https://x.com/sidan_lab/status/1985292595787182091?s=20
2) Establish at least five mentor-mentee pairs to support ongoing projects.
The mentorship program has been rolled out and is successfully completed with the great success that mentees not only started to engage, but also 4/5 mentees sticking around with us and learn and build along side our devs.

A concise report can be found at:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Acu5m5FS3D9TCxM_yJQcGvJUitItgqCEuSu2mkTur8g/edit?usp=sharing
